paragraphs: Rabbi Levi bar Zekharyah: [Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:14](https://www.sefaria.org/Shir_HaShirim_Rabbah.1.14.3). R’ Nachmani bar Zekharyah: [Shabbat 127a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.127a.4).
Rabbi Shimon bar Zekharyah: [Jerusalem Talmud Demai 2:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Demai.2.1.15).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Shabbat has Rav Nechumi ask Abaye, beside Hyman’s Nachmani. [Heilprin’s Nechumi entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2635&lang=en) also gives the question.

The linked midrash names Rabbi Levi bar Zekharyah. In the linked Demai Rabbi Yonah speaks in the name of Rabbi Shimon ben Zekharyah. [Heilprin’s Shimon entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3498&lang=en) gives bar, as Hyman does.
